newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Yen prominent in low Hungary FX futures trade.
newsitem.headline: Yen prominent in low Hungary FX futures trade.

text.p: The yen saw the only substantial turnover on a low-key Hungarian forex futures market on Tuesday.

The Budapest Commodity Exchange (BCE) financial section saw 1.25 billion forints turnover, of which the yen accounted for over 60 percent, while the Budapest Stock Exchange (BSE) saw no forex futures trade.
September and December were the most popular months, with September yen falling 45 fillers to 156.9 forints per 100 yen and December falling 56 fillers to 163.19.
The September dollar quote fell 63 fillers to 188.57 forints and December remained steady at 194.00.
The Swiss franc was also mixed, falling 16 fillers to 131.82 for September and rising 30 fillers to 136.70 for December.
The BSE saw no price changes.
Tuesday's central bank midday fix for the Swiss franc was 121.21 forints, up 0.14, while the yen was quoted at 143.12 per 100 yen, down 0.84 and the dollar was fixed at 176.58, down 0.37.
